methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.

actual_scope: Probe unchanged package source-reader compatibility and cold hydration requirements under full-history blob filtering, without applying workflows or claiming hosted speedup.
scope_change_reason: Observed CI acquisition delays motivate an exact transport compatibility experiment before optimization. The card speedup acceptance gate is not claimed; this result isolates old-source hydration and evidence preservation.
bottleneck_link: A filter can omit unused historical blobs, but unchanged validators must access declared old sources and preserve ancestry/modes; this bounded probe tests that seam.
stop_rule: One fixed local Git origin and three clients; retain first automatic hydration outcome, separate declared manual positive and strict failures; stop science at21:07UTC.
